rules.statement: A person interested in the matter, but not a party to the action, may apply for a stay of execution proceedings under section 343 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: There is nothing in the section to prevent a person interested in the matter being heard. On the contrary, it is declared that all persons interested in the matter of the execution should be made parties. If such persons, though not themselves parties, may be made parties for the purpose of the application, there seems every reason why they should be allowed to make the application, if necessary, themselves.
